title: Live: Two blasts rock Afghanistan's Jalalabad city as diplomatic efforts intensify
summary: Two loud explosions rocked Jalalabad in eastern Afghanistan on Saturday morning, as Pakistan said that 37 locations had been subject to aerial targeting since its operation began. This comes as the European Union called for ​both sides to de-escalate and engage in dialogue, while the United Nations urged an immediate end to hostilities. Follow our liveblog…
